repos.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 352 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 550+ contributors
repos.one_liner: A unified AI gateway providing a single endpoint for over 350 LLM providers and 1200+ models.
bullets: Built with TypeScript to provide a standardized API interface across diverse LLM backends.
Acts as a high-performance proxy/gateway for AI-driven applications and coding assistants.
Enables seamless switching between providers like Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, and Gemini without code changes.
Ideal for fintech and enterprise apps requiring multi-model redundancy and cost-optimized inference.

repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.one_liner: An agentic skills framework and methodology designed for autonomous software development.
bullets: Implements a structured framework for defining and executing agentic workflows.
Focuses on bridging the gap between high-level intent and executable software engineering tasks.
Provides a methodology for managing agent state and skill-based task decomposition.
Useful for building autonomous coding agents that can handle complex infrastructure or data tasks.

repos.name: google/artemis
repos.description: ARTEMIS turns natural-language instructions into reliable Android automation. It automates end-to-end workflows, captures logs for debugging and analysis, and integrates seamlessly with AI coding assistants such as Antigravity, Codex, and Claude Code. On the AndroidWorld benchmark, ARTEMIS achieves a success rate of over 99%.
repos.one_liner: A framework that translates natural language instructions into reliable Android automation workflows.
bullets: Utilizes Python to bridge LLM reasoning with low-level Android UI interaction.
Automates end-to-end testing and complex workflows on mobile devices via natural language.
Includes robust logging and debugging capabilities for analyzing automation failures.
Highly relevant for QA automation in fintech apps where cross-device testing is critical.
